Local-first AI Provider credential manager

Usage: aipass [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  doctor
  completions
  vault
  secret
  accounts
  native-host
  agent
  proxy
  unlock       Unlock the vault with master password
  lock
  init
  add          Add a provider credential to the vault [aliases: credential, credentials]
  list
  update
  archive
  restore
  delete
  search
  probe
  get
  copy
  env
  inject
  exec
  configure
  switch
  rollback
  sync
  help         Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --json
      --vault <VAULT>        [env: AIPASS_VAULT_DIR=]
      --password <PASSWORD>  [env: AIPASS_MASTER_PASSWORD=]
  -h, --help                 Print help
  -V, --version              Print version
